headlines.title: ConocoPhillips (COP) Earnings Beat And Dividend Hike Put Valuation Back In Focus
headlines.summary: ConocoPhillips (COP) just put fresh numbers on the table with its third quarter 2026 earnings, pairing higher reported revenue and net income with updated production guidance and an 11% dividend increase. That backdrop has kept ConocoPhillips in focus, with the share price up 15.9% over the past 90 days and 40.9% year to date, even though the 7 day share price return declined 11.5% and short term momentum cooled ahead of this earnings release.

headlines.title: ConocoPhillips Just Raised Its Dividend 11%. Is It a Better Buy Than Murphy Oil?
headlines.summary: Two oil producers just posted strong quarters, but only one turned its cash flow into a payout that can survive a price slump. For income investors, the gap between a bigger yield and a safer check may surprise you.

headlines.title: Is ConocoPhillips a Buy After Its Latest Earnings Report?
headlines.summary: The oil giant delivered strong earnings and raised its dividend, but its biggest cash-flow growth could still be ahead.

headlines.title: COP Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Cash Flow Growth and Lower Spending
headlines.summary: ConocoPhillips targets $7B in free cash flow improvement by 2029, with lower capital spending, growing production and higher shareholder returns driving its outlook.

description: ConocoPhillips explores for, produces, transports, and markets crude oil, bitumen, natural gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and natural gas liquids. It operates in five segments: Alaska; Lower 48; Canada; Europe, Middle East and North Africa; and Asia Pacific. The company's portfolio includes unconventional plays in North America; conventional assets in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia; global LNG developments; oil sands assets in Canada; and an inventory of global exploration prospects. It serves in the United States, Canada, China, Equatorial Guinea, Libya, Malaysia, Norway, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and internationally. ConocoPhillips was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
